I don't know that we've gotten to the idea of like figuring out how to package and syndicate and all that yet. We're probably not quite there yet, but absolutely we need to figure out how do we create the structures where we can actually take down some of this risk. Certainly the data centers don't particularly want this. And also I think one of the keys is if you can actually start taking out some of these risks, it makes these projects way more financeable, right? Like what we've heard from some of the parties is actually if we can get the right product, we actually wind up getting paid to take off risk, right? Because they get a better financing rate from the banks. Ultimately the banks would be willing to do more of these projects. Like there's a lot of efficiency that ultimately just comes from it. And we've been told legitimately like, If you can get this to work at this right price, it actually will save us money. It's not just that we're taking a risk off the table. So that's where things really start to change is if you can start to sort of create this integrated system where like the banks are saying like, okay, this is what you do. Like they do with other forms of insurance. Like you want this loan, you need to have this product that's part of it. And everyone's trying to figure out data centers right now and in AI because you went from nothing to this incredible amount of dollars that's in there. And it's all you hear about in financial circles and it moves the markets more than any other vector.
turns.zh: 这是个很棒的想法。你知道，我们喜欢这类创新的东西。我不确定我们已经想到“怎么去打包、辛迪加分销”那一步。我们大概还没到那儿，但绝对需要想清楚：我们如何构建出一些结构，让我们真的能吃下其中一部分风险。当然，数据中心方并不特别想要这个风险。而且我觉得关键之一是：如果你真能开始剥离其中一些风险，会让这些项目变得好融资得多，对吧？我们从一些对手方那里听到的是——如果我们能拿到合适的产品，我们最终甚至是“拿钱来剥离风险”的，对吧？因为他们能从银行拿到更好的融资利率。最终银行会愿意做更多这类项目。这里面蕴含着大量效率。有人一本正经地跟我们说过：“如果你能把这东西以合适的价格做成，它其实会帮我们省钱。”而不只是我们把一个风险从桌面上拿走了。事情真正开始改变的地方就在这里：如果你能开始构建这种一体化的系统，让银行说“好，这就是你要做的”——就像他们对其他形式保险做的那样，“你想要这笔贷款，你就得有这个产品作为其中一部分”。现在所有人都在琢磨数据中心、琢磨 AI，因为你从什么都没有，一下子到了这么多令人难以置信的钱砸在里面。这是你在金融圈里唯一听得见的东西，它比任何其他因素都更能撼动市场。

turns.en: I tend to think that like, If the need is to bear $ 10 trillion of Frontier Lab and hyperscaler credit risk, that's like– it's like it'd be Susquehanna.
turns.zh: 我倾向于这么想：如果需求是要承担10万亿美元的前沿实验室（Frontier Lab）和超大规模云厂商（hyperscaler）的信用风险，那——那基本上就是 Susquehanna 了。

turns.en: No, it's not. It is not going to be us that ultimately is going to take all that risk. It's going to be– It's going to be us that bootstraps it, right? We need to get the proof of concept.
turns.zh: 不，不是。最终接下所有这些风险的不会是我们。会是我们来把它引导启动（bootstrap），对吧？我们需要做出概念验证。

turns.en: You're going to run a CDS desk and like– I'm just going to say AIG, but like some insurance company is.
turns.zh: 你们会去运营一个 CDS 交易台，然后——我就直说 AIG 吧——某家保险公司会——

turns.en: Going to own– That's absolutely what we'd like. We like taking risk. We'd like to take some of the risk, but what we'd really like to do is to build that market in an efficient way. So we become this cog that helps that market to function efficiently, which is our role, right? We take on risk, but we help the market to function efficiently. And ultimately, yeah, we're working with an AIG or we're working with whichever insurers and other sort of like mechanisms that there are to distribute that risk, right? Like It's funny because a lot of the things in prediction, we're just like, yeah, we'll warehouse it because we're big enough that like most of the prediction things, like we can just be like, yeah, we'll take it, whatever. It's millions of dollars. You're big for a goat herder.
turns.zh: ——持有（这些风险）。那正是我们希望的。我们喜欢承担风险，我们愿意承担其中一部分，但我们真正想做的，是以一种高效的方式把那个市场建起来。于是我们变成让那个市场高效运转的一个齿轮（cog），这就是我们的角色，对吧？我们承担风险，但我们帮助市场高效运转。而最终，是的，我们会跟一家 AIG 合作，或跟任何保险公司、以及其他各种分销该风险的机制合作，对吧？有意思的是，预测市场里很多东西我们就是“行，我们囤着”，因为我们足够大——大多数预测类的东西，我们就能直接说“行，我们接了，无所谓”，那不过是几百万美元。对一个牧羊人来说你们算大的。

turns.en: We're big for a goat herder. You're big for a soccer relegation. Right.
turns.zh: “对一个牧羊人来说你们算大的。你们对一次足球降级也算大的。”对吧。

turns.en: But we're small for the entirety of data center. So we can take down trades that are large, but like I suppose- Gives you a little humility when you're used to feeling like you're the big player until you get involved in data centers. Like, oh, we're looking for $ 10 billion. Like, okay, let's think about how.
turns.zh: 但相对于整个数据中心领域，我们就很小了。所以我们可以接下很大的交易，但我想——当你习惯了觉得自己是个大玩家，直到你卷入数据中心，这会给你一点谦卑。比如“哦，我们要找100亿美元”，那就“好吧，我们来想想怎么——”

turns.en: To do this. Jeremy Mallitz, thank you so much for joining us.
turns.zh: ——做成这件事。Jeremy Maletz，非常感谢你来做客。

turns.en: Thank you for having me here. It's been very fun.
turns.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我来，非常有趣。
